tech-lead.description: Orchestrator for the demo tech department. Decomposes the user task and delegates to specialists, coordinating the full flow.
tech-lead.triggers: build feature, full flow, orchestrate, coordinate, tech lead, end to end, demo build, delegate to team

cloud-architect.description: Designs AWS architecture, selects services, and produces diagrams (awsdac YAML + mingrammer).
cloud-architect.triggers: architecture, solution design, AWS diagram, service selection, diagram, cost estimate

infra-engineer.description: Writes Terraform/CloudFormation and provisions AWS infrastructure for the demo.
infra-engineer.triggers: terraform, cloudformation, IaC, provision infra, deploy infrastructure, VPC, EKS, ECS

backend-dev.description: Writes backend code: APIs, services, and lambdas for the demo.
backend-dev.triggers: backend, API, lambda, service code, endpoint, business logic

frontend-dev.description: Writes frontend code and UI for the demo.
frontend-dev.triggers: frontend, UI, react, component, styling, web app

qa-tester.description: Writes and runs tests (unit, integration, e2e) and enforces quality gates.
qa-tester.triggers: tests, QA, unit test, integration test, e2e, quality gate, coverage

code-reviewer.description: Reviews PRs, validates standards, and approves or requests changes.
code-reviewer.triggers: code review, review PR, approve, request changes, standards check

security-engineer.description: Reviews vulnerabilities, IAM policies, and compliance for the demo.
security-engineer.triggers: security, vulnerability, IAM policy, compliance, least privilege, secrets scan

cicd-engineer.description: Configures CI/CD pipelines, builds, deploys, and monitoring for the demo.
cicd-engineer.triggers: pipeline, CI/CD, codepipeline, build, deploy, monitoring, observability
